source_time_text: Sep 23, 7:32pm Forex Factory (site time; absolute story timestamp)

evidence.dominant_driver: Japan's September flash PMI showed broad growth cooling: manufacturing PMI fell to 54.1 from 54.9, output growth slowed to a three-month low and new-order growth to a four-month low; services and overall activity also softened while inflation remained intense.

market_expectations.distribution_notes: No reliable consensus value was available in the scanned story; forecast therefore uses the change versus August and underlying components, not a fabricated consensus surprise.

components.prices: input/output inflation still rapid; output-price inflation only slightly below August record

absorption.reason: The release was about 150 minutes old at decision time. Rather than falling on the softer PMI, the Nikkei cash market opened higher and by 10:00 JST was up 1.77%, showing the PMI growth-negative impulse had been overwhelmed by catch-up buying, weak-yen support and tech strength.

observed_reaction.NI225: 66,167.10 at 10:00 JST, +1,148.15 / +1.77% versus previous close; opened +457.49

observations.USDJPY: around 158.29 before the open, yen weakness supportive for exporters
observations.JGB10Y: 2.978% in the latest pre-open market snapshot
observations.US10Y: 5.104%, sharply higher and a valuation headwind
observations.US_tech: Nasdaq -1.13% and SOX -1.23% at US close, but Japanese semiconductor leaders were strong after Tokyo reopened

evidence.decision_notes: Residual forecast from 02:02:30 UTC only. The leakage-safe learning_profile.json is empty, so learning made no confidence adjustment.

BRENT.regime: no sufficiently fresh reliable value found in the pre-decision scan

regimes.japan_equities: strong catch-up rally after multi-day holiday closure

immediate.rationale: The PMI signal has been overwhelmed by a strong cash-session rally; after a large opening advance, residual PMI direction is weak.

next_session.rationale: If the catch-up rally fades, slower activity/new orders plus still-intense inflation can become a mild next-session headwind.

15m.rationale: The PMI signal has been overwhelmed by a strong cash-session rally; after a large opening advance, residual PMI direction is weak.

1h.rationale: Weak PMI growth conflicts with strong price action, weak-yen support and catch-up buying after the holiday closure.

4h.rationale: The softer activity signal may cap gains, but current market confirmation is opposite and the index is already extended higher.

next_session.rationale: If the catch-up rally fades, slower activity/new orders plus still-intense inflation can become a mild next-session headwind.

predictions.mechanism: Softer domestic activity/new orders are equity-negative at the margin, but weak-yen exporter support and holiday catch-up flows are dominating current price action.
predictions.invalidation: A sustained break to fresh session highs with broadening breadth would further invalidate the residual bearish PMI thesis; conversely, a loss of the opening range would strengthen it.
predictions.counter_case: The PMI remains expansionary at 54.1, overseas demand is solid, and the weak yen plus catch-up demand can keep Japanese equities rising despite slower month-on-month momentum.
